question.text: Figure shows a copper rod joined to a steel rod. The rods have equal length and equal crosssectional area. The free end of the copper rod is kept at $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ and that of steel rod is kept at $100^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. Find the temperature of the junction of the rod. Conductivity of copper $=390 \mathrm{~W} / \mathrm{m}^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ Conductivity of steel $=46 \mathrm{~W} / \mathrm{m}^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$
